harness.name: AntiFox
harness.description: ARTEX derivative; Chinese-language agentic pentest platform

actors.name: Unattributed AntiFox operators
actors.note: Arctic Wolf names no actor; AntiFox hosted on Alibaba Cloud

harness.whatItDid: Infrastructure hosting AntiFox on Alibaba Cloud was “associated with” confirmed intrusions: a web exploit, an IIS web shell, AWS credential checks and a successful read of a production secret. Arctic Wolf ties the activity to the infrastructure, not to the tool itself.

uses.quote: In several recently observed intrusions, Alibaba Cloud systems hosting AntiFox interfaces were associated with confirmed malicious actions against internet-facing web services and associated AWS environments.
Activity eventually progressed to a successful GetSecretValue request against a production secret.
